title: AnimationLibrary
description: Data file content/animation/library.json: every action and expression of the vocabulary, the idle behaviour, gaits and special moves mapped to a clip (B2 R27-R29). Unknown ids get the fallback clip and a log entry. Idle weights depend on core values (needs and moods 0..1); the choice is deterministic from inhabitant id and tick and not part of the hash (B2514 T4).

clips.description: Clips and how they are made.

mappings.description: Vocabulary or library id to clip.

gaits.description: Gaits by speed, ascending; the gait blends steplessly.

source.description: asset: a clip from a CC0 GLB; blend: mix of other clips; procedural: LookAt/IK in code; placeholder: not yet made.

asset.description: Name of the clip in the figure GLB (source asset; the importer drops the _Loop suffix). The asset clips of this file are the allowlist of approved clips: the game plays no other clip of the GLB, and clips that show violence are never approved (B2466).

target.description: Only for kind action: this mapping applies when the action is aimed at this kind of target (inhabitant: another inhabitant; object: a thing of the world). A mapping without target applies otherwise. Lets an action bend down only for a thing on the ground, never towards another inhabitant (Marcel W1687).

min_speed_cm_s.description: Game-time speed (distance per game second, not per real second) from which this gait applies; also its point in the gait blend.

ground_speed_cm_s.description: Speed the clip's feet show over the ground at playback speed 1 and figure scale 1 (placeholder estimate); the gait plays faster or slower to roughly match the on-screen speed.

speed_spread.description: Variety: each time this behaviour is drawn it plays up to this share faster or slower than its clip (e.g. 0.15 = 0.85..1.15 times), deterministic from inhabitant id and idle slot. Missing: 0.

mirror.description: Variety: whether this behaviour may play mirrored (left and right swapped, half of the draws), deterministic from inhabitant id and idle slot. Missing: never.

value.description: A need, mood or trait id (values 0..1; for needs 1 = fully satisfied).

when.description: low: weight grows as the value falls; high: as it rises.
